narrative.overview: ergo.de is a calm, approachable catalogue: white pages broken into full-width pastel bands, white 8px cards, one saturated Bordeaux for every action and claim, FS Me for UI and body with Fedra Serif claims.
keyCharacteristics: Split hero on a pastel band
FS Me kicker above Fedra Serif 28px h2
Pastel band alternation via AEM style-system classes

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Bordeaux is the only saturated colour on a page; pastels carry the mood, red carries the action.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-H1 Rule
rules.body: The semantic h1 is the small FS Me eyebrow; the visual headline is a p.txt__claim in Fedra Serif.

dos: Do keep every action in Bordeaux #8e0038 and every claim in Fedra Serif.
Do alternate full-width pastel bands with white sections.
Do keep cards at 8px radius and buttons at 12px.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, dark sections or heavy shadows.
Don't use the logo red #bf1528 for UI.
Don't promote the eyebrow to a large heading; the claim carries the visual weight.
